description: Two 64x64 plates, 64 apart, facing each other (normals toward each other), lightmap scale 4 (16x16 patches each). Used for the form-factor analytic test: summing the differential form factor from one plate's patches to the other's converges to the exact double-integral value (checked against an independent fine-grid integration, ~0.1999 for this geometry). No lights: the test uses RadiosityBake.FormFactor directly, not Bake.
name: parallel-plates
